depiction.primary_object: outlined head and shoulders bust of a single person
depiction.composition: single bust facing forward with plus sign to the upper right

readings.meaning: add a person, contact, user, or member
invite someone, send a friend request, or share access with a new user
hire, recruit, or onboard a new employee
register or create a new user account

ambiguity: Opposite in meaning to the person-with-minus-sign icon; at very small sizes the plus sign could be misread as a medical cross (doctor) or overlooked when scanning quickly alongside other user-action icons.

reasoning: The icon is the universal UI glyph for 'add person' (a user bust with a plus sign). It fits a common set of tasks across life and work: saving a new contact, inviting someone to a group or event, adding a family member to a policy or account, and onboarding or hiring.
